title: Tensor products of finite generating families generate the tensor product module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal F_1,\ldots,\mathcal F_n$ be $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and for each $i$ let $s_{i,0},\ldots,s_{i,m_i}$ be global sections generating $\mathcal F_i$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Then the finitely many global sections $s_{1,j_1}\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\cdots\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}s_{n,j_n}$, with $0\le j_i\le m_i$, generate $\mathcal F_1\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\cdots\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal F_n$.

proof.text: For each i, [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections] gives the finite direct-sum map q_i: \bigoplus_{j=0}^{m_i}\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal F_i whose j-th summand sends 1 to s_{i,j}. By [lem-weil-pbc-locally-surjective-iff-stalks], q_i is surjective exactly when, for every x in X, the germs (s_{i,j})_x generate the O_{X,x}-module (F_i)_x.

source.place: Sheaves, Definition 007U and Lemma 0H7H(2), surjectivity is equivalent to surjectivity on stalks

proof.text: For every x, induction on k identifies the stalk of F_1 tensor_{O_X} ... tensor_{O_X} F_k with (F_1)_x tensor_{O_{X,x}} ... tensor_{O_{X,x}} (F_k)_x, with the germ of every pure tensor mapping to the pure tensor of its germs: the case k=1 is trivial, and the induction step is [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-tensor] applied to the k-fold product viewed as (F_1 tensor ... tensor F_{k-1}) tensor F_k. In particular, the germ of s_{1,j_1} tensor ... tensor s_{n,j_n} maps to (s_{1,j_1})_x tensor ... tensor (s_{n,j_n})_x.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 17.16.1 (Tag 01CB), iterated by induction on the number of factors

proof.text: For a ring A, if each A-module M_i is generated by the finite family (s_{i,j})_j, then M_1 tensor_A ... tensor_A M_n is generated by the pure tensors s_{1,j_1} tensor ... tensor s_{n,j_n}: every pure tensor expands multilinearly in these generators, and pure tensors span the tensor product.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AO, elementary tensor-product construction (pure tensors span and multilinearity)

proof.text: Combining steps 1--3, for every x the germs of the displayed global sections generate the stalk of F_1 tensor_{O_X} ... tensor_{O_X} F_n. Let q be the map from the finite direct sum indexed by tuples (j_1,...,j_n) to that tensor product, sending the tuple basis section to s_{1,j_1} tensor ... tensor s_{n,j_n}. The stalk map q_x is surjective by the preceding generation statement, so [lem-weil-pbc-locally-surjective-iff-stalks] makes q surjective. By [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], this is exactly that the displayed sections generate the tensor product.
